approval_note: Owner approval for merge, 2026-11-03. Owner answer: approved PR #56, the INT-10 fix (approve_56).
plan: INT-10: scripts/probe_curve_layout.py must never write VERIFIED. It writes DECODED_PENDING_REVIEW in the JSON record and in docs/CURVE_LAYOUT_PROBE.md after a successful getAccountInfo decode, following scripts/probe_pump_accounts.py. A human sets VERIFIED by a reviewed doc change. Draft pull request against main; do not merge.
purpose: Removes the automatic VERIFIED write on a successful decode. Keeps the ASSUMED path and every other output field unchanged. Round 1 adds a red-then-green test for the decode record path. Round 2 adds the same review paragraph to the ASSUMED doc template through one constant, _REVIEW_NOTE, that both writers use, with a red-then-green test for the ASSUMED path. Ownership: scripts/** is owned by bot-00-chief in ownership.yaml, and no more specific entry names probe_curve_layout.py. The first ownership read was a read-only check from the owner checkout; the recorded checks run in the worktree.

claims.claim: On origin/main, before the fix, the decoded-path test fails because the successful decode record writes layout_status VERIFIED.
After the fix, the decoded-path test passes: the JUnit report shows one test with no failures or errors.
The pump-accounts probe test module still passes: JUnit report shows 16 tests with no failures or errors.
make lint passes: ruff check and ruff format --check report no findings.
The two touched Python files pass ruff format --check.
The G-1 ownership manifest validates in the worktree.
Before the fix, the ASSUMED-path test fails because the ASSUMED doc template lacks the review paragraph.
After the fix, both probe tests pass: the JUnit report shows two tests with no failures or errors, and the ASSUMED doc carries the review paragraph from the same constant the decoded writer uses.
The ASSUMED run exits 0 with no account configured, makes no RPC call, and writes Status: ASSUMED with the review paragraph; its only change to the committed probe.json is probed_at.

Across both rounds the diff changes only the status and note lines of the two writers, the module docstring, the one review-note constant, the new tests, and the regenerated fixture and doc. Every other record and doc field is unchanged.

Before the round-three wording fix, the docs and curve probe tests fail: the review paragraph carries the uppercase token VERIFIED, which the ASSUMED-state docs test forbids, and the expected-account test still asserts VERIFIED.
After the wording fix and the stale-test update, all 18 tests in the docs and curve probe modules pass: the JUnit report shows 0 failures and 0 errors.
The pump-accounts probe test module still passes: the JUnit report shows 16 tests with 0 failures.
make lint passes: ruff check and ruff format --check report no findings.
The three touched Python files pass ruff format --check.
The committed docs/CURVE_LAYOUT_PROBE.md contains no uppercase VERIFIED token.

The round-three diff changes only the review-paragraph wording in one constant and the committed doc, and one stale expected-account test that now asserts DECODED_PENDING_REVIEW. Probe behaviour is unchanged.

unverified: No live mainnet getAccountInfo call was made. The RPC call is stubbed in the decoded-path test, so the ASSUMED layout has not been decoded against a real bonding-curve account.
The full repository test suite and the soak test were not run. Only the two probe test modules and make lint were run.
No human reviewer has set the status to the verified value. Owner approval of PR 56 does not promote the layout, and the probe never sets it.
CLAUDE.md line 105 and .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md MKT-03 still describe a live probe as confirming the layout. They are not updated in this draft PR.
deviations: The first edit attempts used repo-relative paths. The edit tool resolved them to the owner checkout /root/src/repos/pumpgrok, and the edits were rejected on hash mismatch, so nothing was written there. Later edits used absolute worktree paths. The owner checkout's scripts/probe_curve_layout.py was not modified.

One pytest run with -q printed 'No tests collected' and exit 0, while the -v run and the JUnit XML report one passing test. The JUnit XML is cited as the green evidence. The cause of the -q message was not determined. Round 2 runs also printed this message, and the JUnit XML again reports the test counts used as evidence.
Round 2: the ASSUMED run regenerated tests/fixtures/rpc/bonding_curve/probe.json. Its only change is probed_at, and it is committed as the output of that run.

Round 3: test_probe_records_verified_for_expected_account in tests/docs/test_verify_doc_commands_offline.py asserted that a matching account writes VERIFIED. That is the behaviour INT-10 removes, so the test was stale from round 1. It is renamed test_probe_records_pending_review_for_expected_account and asserts DECODED_PENDING_REVIEW. No probe behaviour changed. Main asked for wording only; this test change is the one edit beyond it and is flagged for review.
